result.summary: Implemented apps/bot/src/db/schema.ts (chapters/users/profiles per design), apps/bot/drizzle.config.ts, and a drizzle-kit-generated migration apps/bot/drizzle/0000_tough_lilith.sql (not hand-written, per decision 0005). All 6 ACs verified against a real scratch Postgres container: AC1 \d+ output shows UUID PKs + timestamptz on all three; AC2 two NULL tg_id inserts succeeded, duplicate non-null failed on the unique constraint; AC3 minimal profile insert succeeded with nullable fields reading back NULL; AC4 bare user insert reads back broadcast_opt_in=f, consent_pd_at=NULL, and the profile's publish_consent=f; AC5 git grep for the 5 forbidden computed-value names against the generated SQL returned zero matches; AC6 design artefact's explicit sentence confirmed present. lint/build both exit 0.
